Callout.Name: Child in the Water
Callout.Message: Child pulled from a pool, not breathing.
Callout.Advisory: Parent doing compressions, water coming out.

Script.Line: She was under for a while. I do not know how long.
I pulled her out myself and I did the breaths, the ones they show you.
She coughed. That was the sound I wanted. That was the sound.

Lines.Approach: A parent is doing compressions on her own child. Get there and take over.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
